notes.title: Toy Tactics 1.1A: Release Notes
notes.notes:
We're excited to bring you the latest update for Toy Tactics! This patch addresses several key issues and introduces important fixes to improve your gameplay experience. We’ve been listening closely to your feedback and have worked hard to make sure everything runs smoother than ever. Below is a list of the most significant changes in this update:

Fixes and Changes:
[list]
[*] All achievements are now working.
[*] Polish and Czech special characters have been fixed.
[*] Drawing bugs and missing orders have been resolved.
[*] Minor errors and access problems have been addressed.
[*] Online countdown issues have been fixed.
[*] Emote selection is now supported when using a controller.
[*] Skeleton altar now works for allies in co-op.
[/list]

We hope these improvements enhance your experience with Toy Tactics. As always, we appreciate your continued support and feedback. Stay tuned for more updates, and don't hesitate to let us know if you encounter any other issues or have suggestions for future improvements. Keep those strategies sharp and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Final Update Before Launch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/9354bcdbebb928a7903e1d55216b62e4b72038c4.png[/img]
[h3]As we approach the official release, we’re excited to announce that everything is now finalized. Get ready to sharpen your skills, because the upcoming game modes available at launch will be [b]Multiplayer Versus (1vs1)[/b] and [b]Multiplayer Cooperative (1+1 vs AI)[/b].[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/38eae21483370cff79208b1b920190ce78d61738.png[/img]

    [h3]What’s New in This Update:[/h3][list]
        [*][b]Touchscreen Support:[/b] You can now enjoy full touchscreen functionality.
        [*][b]Scene Updates & Balancing:[/b] Multiple scenes have been updated and rebalanced for better gameplay.
        [*][b]Skirmish Mode Warning:[/b] A new alert will notify you if you attempt to start Skirmish mode without any spells equipped.
        [*][b]Unit Videos in Army Camp:[/b] Watch your units in action with new videos available in the army camp.
        [*][b]Boss Improvements:[/b] Fixed boss attack cancellations and rebalanced their difficulty for a more engaging challenge.
        [*][b]Customization:[/b] Your selected colors are now saved automatically.
        [*][b]Visual Upgrades:[/b] Decals have been replaced with a new system, and trails and particle render orders have been refined.
        [*][b]Enhanced performance:[/b] Improvements to ensure smoother gameplay and faster load times.
        [*][b]Environmental Updates:[/b] Removed underwater vegetation to enhance performance.
        [*][b]Cinematic Additions:[/b][list]
                [*]Visualize army cinematics directly from the camp.
                [*]Enjoy the new boss ending cinematics, everytime you defeat any boss.[/list]		
        [*][b]Gameplay Tweaks:[/b][list]
                [*]Karts now halt when captured by enemies.
                [*]Chest retrieval mechanics have been revised for specific scenarios.
                [*]Improved arrow sticking for more realistic interactions.
                [*]Reworked pathfinding costs for navigating through and around buildings, both intact and destroyed.[/list]
        [*][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][list]
                [*]Various achievements have been corrected.
                [*]Spells on top of buildings are now functioning as intended.
                [*]Resolved issues with specific spells, including Trojan Horse, Galleon, and Barrels.
                [*]Relic fixes, including adjustments to Ghost Area, Wolf Cloak, and Ancilia.[/list]
        [*][b]Audio & Visual Enhancements:[/b][list]
                [*]Credits audio now respects master volume settings.
                [*]Simplified Fireflight light effects for better performance.
                [*]Campaign markers have been resized and modified for improved clarity.[/list][/list]
This will likely be the final update before the official launch, so dive in and explore these changes as you prepare for the big day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/479deeb53943317fb77fb45b1e1dec8916e6d306.png[/img]

notes.title: Toy Tactics Undead Army Update 🔮💀
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=VVG_QnGAn-Y;full][/previewyoutube]
Attention, Tacticians!

I hope you're doing great, or at least feeling a bit better than us... lately, we've been feeling a bit dead inside, not because of anything bad, mind you, but because the entire studio has been working hard on Toy Tactics' latest update: The Awakening of the Undead 💀

This latest update adds a new faction, The Draugr, and with them comes a whole new campaign, new units, new relics, new spells based in necromancy and even a new ship!!

🎃 [b]Limited-Time Demo[/b]: In celebration of Halloween, we're summoning a chilling, limited-time demo for all brave souls. A glimpse into the land of the Skeleton Army and show your enemies that only death is welcome in this land.

[h2]Here's what awaits you in the darkness:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Play as the Undead Army: Your familiar foes are now under your control!
[*]New Spells + Units: Don't worry if the corpses start piling up, your new necromancer ability will bring your enemies back to life and join your army.
[*]New Sceneries: Explore the land of Erebus, a lifeless landscape filled with lava ☄️ where only the Undead can thrive.
[*]Limited-time Halloween Demo: A glimpse into the haunted realm, available for a limited spell.
[*]New game modes: Challenges that will put your strategic skills to the test, like never before.
[/list]
We're eternally grateful for the support you've bestowed upon us. As you embark on this hair-raising adventure with us, keep a watchful eye for what's coming next in Toy Tactics. The Undead Army is rising, and the wobbliest strategy game around is about to get even spookier! 💀👻🎮

notes.title: Pirates Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=enXiaQPK9GU;full][/previewyoutube]
Arr mateys!

We come baring bountiful news! The new [b]Pirates[/b] arrrrr here, and they are rrready to plunder and raid the world and seas you are trying to save! Enjoy new treasurous features, scurvy bug fixes, and squashbuckling changes now available! Make sure to have your swords at the ready and peglegs screwed on for daring adventures!

[h2]Here’s what to Expect:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]New army: Freebooters (The Pirate Army)[/b]
[*]New main units, all ranged
[*]New secondary units
[*]New animals, including parrots, giant crabs and sharks
[*]New setting: Caribbean
[*]New spells related to water and voodoo
[*]New relics to empower Freebooter units
[*]New technology: gunpowder
[*]New abilities and mechanics
[*]New unit state: ghost
[*]New ship: Galleon
[*]New campaign, missions and objectives
[*]New final boss
[*]Unit balance modified to fine-tune relations between units and to increase unit differentiation between factions
[*]Puzzle balance and sorting changed
[*]Projectile system refactorization to improve behavior and collision precision
[*]New interfaces and windows related to bosses and boss levels
[*]Bosses revisited for improvements and adjustments
[*]Boss statistics management
[*]New cameras and camera control
[*]Drawing line animations and feedback revamped
[*]Bug fixes and corrections
[/list]
We also would like to thank all of you for supporting us along this journey! Without you, updates and new content like these won’t be possible!
